items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: performed with a long list of top musicians, including Shelly Manne, Stan Kenton, Sammy Davis Jr., and Frank Sinatra

ctx.x: Multi-talented Jack Sheldon was born in Jacksonville, Florida on November 30, 1931. He was playing gigs on the trumpet by the age of 15, later attending Los Angeles City College after moving west in 1947. Jack established himself as one of the foremost jazz artists on the west coast and performed with a long list of top musicians, including Shelly Manne, Stan Kenton, Sammy Davis Jr., and Frank Sinatra.
